newsitem.title: USA: Higher crude oil prices lift Phillips Q4 earns.
newsitem.headline: Higher crude oil prices lift Phillips Q4 earns.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co said Thursday its fourth quarter operating income was boosted by higher prices for crude oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids.
The gains were partially offset by higher exploration expenses and operating costs, the company said.
Phillips also said that worldwide natural gas production rose seven percent versus a year ago, while crude oil production declined slightly.
The company also reported a susbstantial rise in operating income from its gas gathering and processing units.
The firm attributed a rise in results from downstream, refining and marking operations to higher motor fuel and distillate margins and lower costs.

Phillips said fourth-quarter chemicals income was down slightly due to alower paraxylene and ethylene margins. But earnings benefited from higher polyethyulene margins and higher margins from its natgas liquids processing operations.
